## Context / immutable basis
Exactly 22 bloated prose blocks (21 leading owner docstrings and 1 ordinary full-line comment region; 3,407 base words) are confirmed across 18 paths. Condense repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, and obsolete change history while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

Before-citations and the immutable before-image use current `origin/main@8ff0355e32c6fb1ba67e4964dc12ba1b4c3e45b0`. These test paths moved from `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` to `tests/unit/reconciler/`; the targeted leading docstrings stayed text-identical. Keep both grouped leaves to one commit so path checks use `HEAD^..HEAD`.

## Boundary and immutable oracle
Below, `R` means `tests/unit/reconciler`. `D:<qualified-owner>` identifies only that owner's leading string docstring; `C:<anchor>@Lx-y` identifies one contiguous base comment region. Edit only these IDs. Every block must shrink and state current rationale/constraints; preserve cited literals and behavioral oracles.

Parse base/final source with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`; replace only allowlisted leading docstring values; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require exact attribute-free AST equality. Tokenize independently to preserve directive/shebang text and inline/next-statement attachment. Runtime strings, inline comments, unlisted prose, executable syntax, and zero-context diff hunks outside the base spans remain exact.

## Scope — 22 editable blocks
- `R/test_jira_dc_transport.py` (2) — `D:module`, `D:_LibIssue.add_field_value`; preserve the unwrapped verified-fake contract, optional-extra boundary, issue-resource method ownership, and two-argument signature.
- `R/test_jira_family_boundary_heldout.py` — `D:module`; preserve the acyclic import graph, injected shared layer, no old-path shims/duplicate maps, location pins, and by-path loading.
- `R/test_jira_key_local_id_heldout.py` — `D:module`; preserve deterministic lowercase Jira-key derivation and the live oracle's non-vacuous premise.
- `R/test_jira_vocabulary_decisions_2e47.py` — `D:test_the_unsynced_set_is_exactly_the_four_measured_relations`; preserve the exact four measured unsynced relations and correction of both stale prose lists.
- `R/test_link_mapping.py` — `D:module`; preserve one effective map for add/remove, override direction, skip symmetry, reverse attribution, collision safety, and fail-closed vocabulary.
- `R/test_live_mode_failure_tally.py` (4) — `D:module`, `D:test_live_emit_merges_cutover_tally_deferred_skipped_recovered_degraded`, `C:"S3T3-REROUTE-E2E-HELDOUT-START..."@L591-602`, `D:test_mixed_pass_tally_is_exact_including_recovered`; preserve live manifest removal with truthful/degraded tallies, real coordinator routing, guards, and disjoint counts.
- `R/test_lock_orphan_local_ref.py` — `D:module`; preserve remote-authoritative lock reads/releases, local-ref cleanup, reclaimability, and real-git CAS behavior.
- `R/test_no_resurrection_after_confirmed_delete_3b5f.py` — `D:module`; preserve tombstone suppression, never-bound create control, explicit unretire, and alert observability.
- `R/test_normalize_rich_text_contract.py` — `D:module`; preserve downstream public free-function/port behavior, input variants, always-string return, signature, and shared delegation.
- `R/test_operation_bindings_runtime.py` — `D:module`; preserve immutable operation snapshot composition, selected backend only, captured scope, held-out poisons, and secret safety.
- `R/test_outbound_multi_project.py` — `D:module`; preserve resolved project stamping, unsynced/stale suppression, both transports, reserved-key removal, fallback, and set-aware guard.
- `R/test_parent_breadcrumb_live_search.py` — `D:module`; preserve zero-comment live-fetch emission, unknown/failure safety, append-once dedup, and no unnecessary call.
- `R/test_parent_breadcrumb.py` — `D:module`; preserve nearest represented ancestor, stable tag/marker, default no-op, intervening/omitted/drift gates, and inbound echo suppression.
- `R/test_probe.py` — `D:module`; preserve the offline read-only probe port/factory injection, plain-data axes, CLI/write contract, and portability.
- `R/test_recovery_loud_failures.py` — `D:module`; preserve real-client recovery, deduped bridge alerts, and nonzero recovery tally/log.
- `R/test_remote_ref_deployment_heldout.py` — `D:test_instance_does_NOT_prevent_local_id_collision_between_deployments`; preserve the explicit cross-deployment local-id collision limitation and migration boundary.
- `R/test_retry_after_zero_guard_heldout.py` — `D:module`; preserve zero-as-absent jitter across all three surfaces, positive-header handling, and bounded backoff.
- `R/test_retry_httperror.py` — `D:module`; preserve 429/5xx retry, raw HTTPError identity, nonretryable 4xx behavior, and timeout forwarding.

## Protected exclusions and consumers
All 297 other owner-docstring/full-line-comment blocks are excluded. Concise examples include `test_recovery_failures_defaults_zero` (6 words), `FakeJiraClient` (7), and `test_return_type_is_always_str` (7). Longer exclusions are explicitly load-bearing, notably the `test_jira_vocabulary_decisions_2e47.py` module and 255/IDEA decision oracles, `test_remote_ref_deployment_heldout.py` module/positive cases, live-tally end-to-end teeth, and link-collision guards. Preserve 13 directive tokens/attachments: 5 union-attr ignores, 2 arg-type ignores, 1 misc ignore, 1 E402 noqa, and 4 no-cover pragmas.

Pytest collects every impacted module; `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py` is the prose-policy consumer. Source-reading tests inspect production/config artifacts, not these editable blocks. No targeted `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, doctest, or pydoc consumer was found.

## Independent review receipt
A reviewer who did not author the prose change must post exactly 22 leaf-linked TSV rows:
`path<TAB>block-id<TAB>before-full-SHA:lines<TAB>final-full-SHA:lines<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>directives-exact<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session`

Before citations use `8ff0355e32c6fb1ba67e4964dc12ba1b4c3e45b0`; final citations use the full final SHA. Every after count is lower and all three verdict columns are `PASS`. Missing, duplicate, or extra rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Only the 22 allowlisted base blocks change.
- [x] Every edited block is shorter and current.
- [x] Normalized AST dumps equal the merged commit's current-parent before-image.
- [x] Runtime strings remain AST-identical.
- [x] Directive/shebang text and attachment remain exact.
- [x] `HEAD^..HEAD` changes exactly the 35 declared paths in both grouped leaves.
- [x] Focused pytest passes every impacted module.
- [x] Scoped Ruff check and format verification pass.
- [x] Repository comment hygiene passes.
- [x] The path-scoped diff has no whitespace errors.
- [x] Worktree-venv `make verify` passes without a timeout.
- [x] The non-author TSV contains exactly 22 valid `PASS` rows.

## Verification
Run all seven structured DD commands: `immutable-prose-only`, `exact-leaf-paths`, `focused-tests`, `scoped-ruff`, `comment-hygiene`, `diff-integrity`, and `repository-gates`.
